name: Lichess API
summary: Open API of the Lichess chess server: players, ratings, games (PGN/NDJSON), puzzles, tournaments, TV and cloud engine evaluations.
description: Lichess exposes user profiles and rating histories, full game exports with optional clocks and evals, the daily puzzle, tournaments, broadcasts, a cloud-eval cache of Stockfish analyses and live game streams. Most read endpoints work without a token; a personal API token (free) is needed for private data and some heavier endpoints. Complete monthly game dumps are published separately as CC0.

auth.notes: Public endpoints (users, games export, puzzle/daily, tournaments, cloud-eval) answered without a token; a personal API token (Authorization: Bearer ...) unlocks private data and some write endpoints.

rate_limit.summary: Docs: make one request at a time; on 429 wait a minute or more before retrying. No numeric limit documented.

endpoints.summary: Public profile with ratings per time control
Export a user's games as PGN or NDJSON (stream)
The current daily puzzle with its source game
Cached Stockfish evaluation for a FEN

license.name: Game database CC0; API terms per Lichess ToS (AGPL for the source code)

agent_notes: Send Accept: application/x-ndjson to stream game exports as one JSON object per line instead of PGN. Do requests serially and back off on 429 (waiting a minute is usually enough, per the docs). For millions of games use the monthly dumps on database.lichess.org instead of the API.
caveats: Game and event endpoints are streamed; a plain curl without max= can run for a very long time.
The Lichess opening explorer lives on a different host and was not checked.
